__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes the service's /metrics endpoint.

panels.description: Ledgers the projection trails the network by. Anything sustained above a few dozen ledgers means the indexer is falling behind.
panels.title: Indexer lag

panels.description: The ledger up to which events have been projected.
panels.title: Indexed ledger

panels.description: Charges the keeper settled divided by charges it attempted, over the dashboard range.
panels.title: Keeper success rate

panels.description: Mandates whose status is active in the projection. Requires the business gauges.
panels.title: Active mandates

panels.description: Merchants with at least one active mandate. Requires the business gauges.
panels.title: Active merchants

panels.description: Monthly recurring revenue of the active mandates, normalised to a 30-day month, in the token's smallest unit. Requires the business gauges.
panels.title: MRR (smallest unit)

panels.description: How many ledgers the projection trails the network by, per network.
panels.title: Indexer lag

panels.description: The projected cursor against the latest ledger the RPC node reported. The two lines converging means the indexer has caught up.
panels.title: Cursor vs latest ledger

panels.description: Contract events applied to the projection. A flat line while the chain is producing events means the indexer is stuck.
panels.title: Events applied per second

panels.description: Charges the keeper settled and charges it could not settle, per second.
panels.title: Keeper results per second

panels.description: The share of attempted charges the keeper could not settle. A sustained rise is usually underfunded vaults or an RPC failure.
panels.title: Keeper failure ratio

panels.description: Keeper passes run per second. A gap means the loop is not running, not that there was nothing to settle.
panels.title: Keeper passes per second

panels.description: Charges settled since the process started. The counter resets on restart, which is what Prometheus expects.
panels.title: Charges settled (total)

panels.description: Charges the keeper could not settle since the process started.
panels.title: Charges failed (total)

panels.description: Keeper passes run since the process started.
panels.title: Keeper passes (total)

panels.description: Webhook delivery attempts by outcome (delivered or failed).
panels.title: Webhook deliveries per second

panels.description: Webhook deliveries that failed and are retried with exponential backoff.
panels.title: Webhook delivery failures per second

panels.description: Delivered webhook attempts divided by all delivery attempts over the dashboard range.
panels.title: Webhook delivery success rate

panels.description: 95th-percentile request latency per route. Requires the HTTP latency histogram.
panels.title: Request latency p95 by route

panels.description: Median, 95th and 99th percentile request latency over every route. Requires the HTTP latency histogram.
panels.title: Request latency p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Requests per second by HTTP status code. Requires the HTTP latency histogram.
panels.title: Requests per second by status

panels.description: The share of requests answered with a 5xx. Requires the HTTP latency histogram.
panels.title: 5xx error ratio

panels.description: Active mandates over time, per network. Requires the business gauges.
panels.title: Active mandates by network

panels.description: Merchants with at least one active mandate, per network. Requires the business gauges.
panels.title: Active merchants by network

panels.description: Monthly recurring revenue per network, in the token's smallest unit. Exact decimal, never converted to a float. Requires the business gauges.
panels.title: MRR by network (smallest unit)
